CustomField.description: API name of the field on the counted object that holds the member's User Id. Defaults to OwnerId when blank. Set this to count by a custom lookup instead of record ownership, e.g. Enrollment_Counselor__c. Must be a lookup to User or an Id/Text field holding User Ids.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Field holding the member's User Id. Leave blank for OwnerId.
CustomField.label: Owner Field
